value.rationale: Parameter four on genuine two-dimensional square grids is an explicitly identified obstacle to a recent conjecture, outside the established edge-only and k <= 3 theorems. The five new finite cases supply homotopy, not just previously catalogued ranks, while full D4 characters reveal nontrivial and varying representation structures. The bounded first squares up to 5 by 5 are a natural complete initial classification rather than arbitrary single-subgraph sampling.
